screen.comment: Rules v2.1: one open experiment position; max premium = risk_cap_pct of fund_value (stepdown_cap_pct while fund_value < stepdown_below_fund); 60-180 DTE; |delta| 0.35-0.55; stop -50% / target +100% / time stop at half the DTE at entry; Quantfolio index verdict required (Buy/Buy on weakness for calls).
